name: LOOKS LIKE NO PYO NOW,
tagline: Pick‑Your‑Own Blueberries, Raspberries, Currants & Gooseberries in NH
description: A family-run pumpkin patch in Antrim, NH, LOOKS LIKE NO PYO NOW, grows Strawberries, Raspberries, Apples, Peaches, and Plums. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
